summary: The deb822_repository module adds and removes deb822-format repositories on Debian-based systems and does not update the apt cache itself.
questions: How do I add a .sources style apt repository?
Does deb822_repository run apt update after adding a repo?
What's the modern replacement for apt_repository?

answer_card.title: deb822_repository overview
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.deb822_repository` manages deb822-format (`.sources`) repos on Debian-based distros. It **does not update the cache**; follow with `ansible.builtin.apt: update_cache: yes` when it changes.
